title: Flood relief centres sheltering 38 (Perak), 21 (Sabah), 15 (Selangor) | Borneo Post Online
text: Flood relief centres sheltering 38 (Perak), 21 (Sabah), 15 (Selangor) | Borneo Post Online Wednesday, September 30 Facebook Instagram Twitter YouTube Telegram TikTok You are at: Home » News » Nation » Flood relief centres sheltering 38 (Perak), 21 (Sabah), 15 (Selangor) For the freshest news, join The Borneo Post’s WHATSAPP CHANNEL or find us on TELEGRAM and The Borneo Post on NEWSWAV . IPOH: The number of flood victims at the relief centre at Beruas, Perak remains at 38 from nine families as of this morning. State Disaster Management Committee secretary, Colonel (Civil Defence) Mohd Noor Hassan Ashari said the victims comprising nine men, 12 women, seven boys and 10 girls were from Kampung Padang Serai, Batu Hampar. They are currently sheltered at Sekolah Agama Rakyat Radhuaniah, he said when contacted today. In Sabah, 21 flood victims from five families at Kampung Pantongan Saga, Tenom, were moved to the relief centre at Rumah Kebudayaan Pantongan Saga around 11 pm last night. Sabah Civil Defence Department director, Colonel Mulliadi Al-Hamdi Bin Ladin said Sungai Padas overflowed its bank inundating the victims’ homes. Tenom district officer Madiyem Layapan said when contacted that the Welfare Department had been providing the necessary aid to the victims. He said the river water was still at ‘warning’ level with a slight drop to 176.34 metres at 6 am this morning from 176.45 metres last night. In Shah Alam, the number of flood victims at the relief centre at Surau Kuning Blok B, Sawah Sempadan, Tanjong Karang remained at 15 as of 7 am this morning. Selangor Fire and Rescue operations assistant director Mohd Sani Harul in a statement today said the victims comprising four men, three women, three boys and four girls are from four families. He said the water level in the affected area is 0.1 to 0.3 metres. –Bernama Share.
